title: 2017 Toyota Camry XSE Hood Paint and Grille Replacement
summary: Carcis Autobody Repair repainted the hood and replaced the front grille on a black 2017 Toyota Camry XSE.
story: This 2017 Toyota Camry XSE required front-end body service after sustaining damage to the hood and grille area. The repair scope focused on refinishing the painted hood surface and installing a new replacement front grille assembly.

To execute a proper repaint, technicians prepare the hood panel by removing surface imperfections, sanding, and applying a quality primer base. The panel is then painted with matched black basecoat before applying clearcoat for depth and UV protection. Proper drying and polishing ensure a factory-like gloss across the panel.

Alongside the paint work, the damaged front grille was unbolted and replaced with a new unit. Replacing the grille ensures proper fitment around the front emblem and bumper cover, completing the front-end overhaul.
